दूध एंट्री — सुबह/शाम की शिफ्ट, लीटर, फैट, SNF या CLR। रेट और रकम अपने-आप।

रेट — फिक्स्ड रेट, फैट × रेट, फैट/SNF फ़ॉर्मूला या फैट/CLR। गाय और भैंस के अलग रेट। प्रो राटा बोनस।

रेट चार्ट — अपना चार्ट Excel, PDF या फोटो से लोड करें। किसी ग्राहक के लिए अलग चार्ट भी।

फैट मशीन और तौल मशीन — Bluetooth से जोड़ें, फैट/SNF/CLR और वज़न सीधे एंट्री में आएँ।

कॉपी स्कैन — पुरानी कॉपी (एंट्री रजिस्टर) की फोटो लें, एंट्रियाँ अपने-आप भरें, आप बस चेक करें।

ग्राहक (मेंबर) — फोन के contacts से जोड़ें; नंबर, गाँव और रेट के साथ।

पर्ची — हर एंट्री की पर्ची Bluetooth थर्मल प्रिंटर से प्रिंट करें या WhatsApp पर भेजें।

ग्राहक बिल — हिसाब अवधि आप तय करें: 7, 10, 15 दिन या महीना। पिछला बकाया अपने-आप जुड़े। बिल प्रिंट करें या WhatsApp करें।

स्कैन करके पेमेंट — जिनसे पैसा लेना है, उनके बिल पर आपका UPI QR। ग्राहक स्कैन करे, रकम पहले से भरी हो, पैसा सीधे आपके UPI खाते में।

पेमेंट — दिया/लिया पेमेंट दर्ज करें: कैश, UPI, बैंक, चेक। हर ग्राहक की पासबुक।

खरीद और बिक्री — दूध की खरीद के साथ दूध और सामान की बिक्री भी, स्टॉक के साथ।

रिपोर्ट — दूध दिनवार रिपोर्ट, कुल हिसाब, खरीद/बिक्री रिपोर्ट, औसत FAT/SNF, बकाया राशि।

ग्राहक की पासबुक — आपके ग्राहक भी ऐप में अपनी दूध पासबुक देख सकते हैं।

मेरा नेटवर्क — कई सेंटर, एक हिसाब। अपने ऑपरेटर जोड़ें, सबकी एंट्री एक जगह।

कंप्यूटर पर भी — dairywala.in पर लॉगिन करें, वही डेटा बड़ी स्क्रीन पर।

ऑफ़लाइन भी — नेटवर्क न हो तब भी एंट्री करें; ऑनलाइन होते ही ऑनलाइन बैकअप। नया फोन? लॉगिन करें, पूरा डेटा वापस।

8 भाषाएँ — हिंदी, English, ਪੰਜਾਬੀ, मराठी, ગુજરાતી, தமிழ், ಕನ್ನಡ, తెలుగు।

कोई विज्ञापन नहीं।

शुरू कैसे करें

1. अपना मोबाइल नंबर डालें, OTP WhatsApp पर आएगा।
2. ग्राहक जोड़ें और रेट सेट करें।
3. आज सुबह की एंट्री से शुरू करें।

Milkolect is complete milk collection and dairy management for Android phones and tablets. For dairy plants, sub-plants, BMC, VLC and farmers.

Core Features

• Milk collection: manual and Bluetooth entry for Fat, SNF, CLR, qty and amount. Cow and buffalo, morning and evening sessions.

• Collection modes: Centre Collection Mode, Dock Collection Mode.

• Offline-first: collect without internet. Local storage with auto sync when online.

• FTP and Bond: automatic collection via Bond configuration and FTP transfer.

• External display: live analyzer and scale readings at the counter.

• Milk dispatch: dispatch note, goods receipt and invoice. Bill as per dispatch or receipt liters. Difference report for gaps.

• Bluetooth hardware: up to 5 devices. Analyzers, weighing scales, thermal printers, external displays.

• Thermal printing: collection slips and bills on Bluetooth printers.

• Accounting: additions, deductions, instalments, cattle feed, advances, settlements, sale and purchase returns, milk sale receipts, supplier payments, stock transfer, custom items and suppliers.

• Custom bill heads: per-litre or flat addition and deduction heads.

• TDS: threshold and rate with auto deduction on bills above your limit.

• Slab charges: tiered flat-fee deductions by bill amount slabs.

• Rate charts: normal or step-based Fat / SNF / CLR. Manual or Excel upload.

• Rate adjustments: cow and buffalo differences per group or session. Step-based offsets by quantity.

• Groups: depositor groups with cow and buffalo rate differences on any base chart.

• Parent-child hierarchy: Plant, Sub Plant, BMC, VLC and Farmers. KYC and bank details. Parent-child rate charts and collection settings. Manual add or Excel upload. Child milk collection from parent center.

• Multi-center: manage multiple centres across the hierarchy on mobile.

• SMS and security: SMS after collection or transactions, device tracking, remote logout, secure sessions.

• Languages: English, Hindi and Marathi in app, PDF, Excel and thermal prints.

• Roles: Operator, Supervisor, Accountant and Manager packs
• Center users: staff logins under your center, tied to one role
• Permissions: create, view, edit, delete for Collection, Dispatch, Customers, Reports, Bills, Routes, Vehicles and Settings
• Route assignment: staff see only that route's depositors and children. Owner can collect any route
• Vehicle assignment: tie staff to a tanker for accountability
• Accessible centers: all centers by default, or select specific centers and their children
• Live updates: apply within seconds. Disable user or unassign route to force logout

Users & Roles gates modules. It does not replace Collection, Dispatch, Reports or Bills.

Farmer Login

Farmers use the same Milkolect Android app with their own login.

• Dashboard with CM/BM session summary and rates
• Milk depositions with date and session filters (fat, SNF, CLR, qty, amount)
• Bill reports with deductions, additions, net pay and PDF download

Built for collection, billing, hardware and staff access from plant to farmer.

apps.title: Milk Register
apps.description:
A milk ledger for the Indian dairy trade.

A vendor delivers twice a day, a buyer takes from several vendors, rates change mid-month, and payments arrive in uneven lumps. Milk Register keeps that account straight and lets either side send the other a statement on WhatsApp.

WHAT IT KEEPS

• Parties and rates — vendors you buy from and clients you sell to. Change a rate from a date, and earlier entries keep the rate they were billed at.
• Entries by session — morning and evening, cow or buffalo, as a list or a month calendar with litres and value on every day.
• Payments that settle — money in either direction, applied to the oldest unpaid entries as far as it reaches.
• Reports and Excel — purchases and sales by volume and value, what you owe against what is owed to you, a per-party ledger and a month-by-month breakdown, exportable as a real .xlsx workbook.
• WhatsApp statements — an entry receipt, a payment receipt or a full account. Every message goes from your own WhatsApp.
• Reminders that learn — the app reads your last three weeks and works out which rounds you actually keep, then speaks up only when one is missing.

A RATE IS A DATE, NOT A SETTING

If the rate is a number stored on the vendor, raising it today silently reprices every entry you ever made, and a month you already settled stops adding up. Here a rate is a dated row: an entry is priced from the rate that applied on the entry's own date. Correct last week's litres and it stays at last week's price.

YOUR BOOK STAYS YOURS

Your account and your ledger, and nothing else. Not sold, not shared, not used for advertising. No advertising in the app and no tracking service in it. Your phone book is read only when you tap the button that fills a vendor's number, and only the contact you pick. How messages leave your phone is described below.

SENDING ON WHATSAPP, AND THE ACCESSIBILITY SERVICE

By default nothing is sent on your behalf: WhatsApp opens with the message already typed and the send is yours to press.

There is one optional setting, "Send automatically", which is off unless you turn it on. With it on, Milk Register uses Android's accessibility service to press send in WhatsApp for you and return to the app. While that setting is on, the service can read what is on the screen inside WhatsApp. It uses this only to find the send button for the message you just chose to share, and only in the few seconds after you tap share. It never runs in any other app, nothing it reads is stored or sent anywhere, and you can turn it off in Android's settings or in the app at any time. Before the setting can be switched on, the app explains all of this and asks you to agree.

Free. There is also a web panel at milkregister.com for the same ledger in a browser.

DFMS (Dairy Farm Management System), created by Cowgenic, is the ultimate all-in-one software solution designed to digitize, optimize, and revolutionize your dairy operation. Say goodbye to guesswork and scattered records. DFMS provides powerful, integrated tools that bring every essential aspect of your farm under a single, easy-to-use platform, boosting efficiency, productivity, and profitability.
Key Modules and Uses of DFMS
DFMS is built on powerful modules that address the core needs of a modern dairy farm:
1. Breeding Health System
Proactively manage your herd's reproductive cycle and health.
Heat & Insemination Tracking: Accurately log cycles, insemination dates, and expected calving dates to maintain optimal calving intervals.
Health Records: Maintain detailed, chronological records of vaccinations, treatments, illnesses, and vet visits for every animal, ensuring informed decisions and better welfare.
Genetic Reporting: Track sire and dam performance to make data-driven decisions for herd improvement.
2. Milking Production Management
Maximize your yield and ensure top quality with precise data.
Individual Cow Yield Tracking: Monitor and analyze milk production for each cow to quickly identify high and low performers.
Production Analytics: Generate reports on herd-wide trends and lactation curves to adjust management and feeding strategies effectively.
Quality Monitoring: Log key quality parameters (SCC, fat, protein) to ensure high standards and spot potential health issues early.
3. Feeding System Optimization
Control your largest expense with accurate ration and inventory management.
Ration Formulation: Create, manage, and adjust custom feed rations for different groups (lactating, dry, heifers) based on nutritional needs.
Feed Inventory Tracking: Monitor real-time stock levels of all components and receive automated alerts for low stock to prevent shortages.
Cost Analysis: Track feed costs per unit of milk produced to determine true profitability.
4. Stock Management System
Efficiently manage all farm assets and non-feed inventory.
Inventory Tracking: Keep a running log of essential supplies (medicines, supplements, cleaning products).
Asset Register: Maintain records for all farm equipment, including maintenance schedules and warranty information.
Cattle Inventory: Maintain a dynamic, accurate count and location of all groups of cattle.
5. Account Management System
Gain complete financial clarity and control over cash flow.
Income & Expense Tracking: Log all farm-related transactions, including milk and cattle sales.
Profitability Analysis: Generate clear Profit & Loss (P&L) statements to know your true cost of production.
Invoicing & Billing: Easily generate invoices and track outstanding payments.
6. Employee and Payroll System
Streamline HR tasks and manage your team efficiently.
Time & Attendance: Log and track employee working hours accurately.
Payroll Processing: Calculate wages, deductions, and generate pay slips, ensuring compliance and simplifying complex payroll tasks.
Task Management: Assign specific tasks to employees and monitor completion status for better workflow and accountability.
DFMS by Cowgenic is your strategic partner for a smarter, more sustainable, and significantly more profitable dairy operation. Invest in DFMS and take control of your farm's future.

apps.title: MU Milk Saathi
apps.description: Introduction The MU Milk Saathi App is developed to have transparency among milk societies. With the absolutely free MU Milk Saathi Application, you get precise and real-time visibility into the union’s different milk collection units and involved farmers. The data and insights are stored in one place with swift notifications to connect and attend to each of the farmers. Key Features of the MU Milk Saathi App • One of the main windows showcases detailed data and timing, cow and buffalo milk fat percentage, milk gathered from cow and buffalo, member fraction based on gender, the involved societies, and milk collection chart. •The application enables to check and track live milk collection at all specific unions. The window showcases data that includes the precise percentage of fat, total quantity of milk, the related payments, and attached sample number. •The app users can view Union-wise data and insights. The user merely requires choosing a specific union name right from the list of attached unions, and the data will be showcased respectively. •With this application, the user can see the real-time milk collection based on any of the 3 filters offered. The filters comprise society-wise milk, shift-wise milk, and date-wise milk gathered, and the user can select from these provided options. •A simple to follow user menu offers different choices provided by the application, such as the comprehensive app dashboard, real-time milk collection details, society-wise milk gathered, all the society-wise details. •One of the useful and valuable windows showcases real-time milk collection at the chosen society as per the specific union. It also provides functionality to filter insights based on chosen cattle, shift details and related dates, and the information is showcased accordingly. •The following window displays a complete summary of milk collection data records at all the societies. It comprises information such as the applicable society name, commencement and end time, total milk quantity, amount of milk fat and attached payment details. •This other app window offers fundamental information of a precise society which includes details such as user code and name, society details like name and code, the applied region, chairman details and concerned contact person information. •The application also has the feature to send notifications which can include society count with details regarding manual milk collection by societies. All the notifications will be showcased on the app to keep a close watch on different milk collection accounts. Benefits from MU Milk Saathi App •The app offers the real-time status of society-wise milk collection and related performance directly to the involved Milk Union. •It assists in identifying any of the errors or malpractices involved across the supply chain. •The application offers a precise platform to the Milk Union to engage with involved farmers and help them in different processes. •Access to predictive analysis and BI reports facilitate the Milk Union to take explicit and data-driven business decisions assisting all the involved stakeholders.

apps.title: Dairywala SMS
apps.description:
Dairywala SMS is a simple, fast messaging app — and it saves dairy owners the job of texting every farmer by hand.

A MESSAGING APP, FIRST

Read and reply to all your text messages in one clean list. Conversations are grouped by person, contact names are shown instead of bare numbers, and new messages arrive with a notification you can reply to without opening the app. Everything you expect from the messaging app on your phone, in Hindi, and light enough for a basic Android.

RECEIPTS THAT SEND THEMSELVES

If you also use the Dairywala app to run your dairy, this is where it earns its place. Today you type the milk entry, then open your messaging app and press send — for every farmer, twice a day. With Dairywala SMS set as your messaging app, the receipt goes out on its own, straight from your own SIM.

YOU SEE WHAT ARRIVED

Most apps send a message and forget it. This one checks. Every receipt shows as delivered, or failed with the reason — no signal, wrong number — and the ones that failed can be sent again in one tap. You are never left guessing whether a farmer got their parchi.

FROM YOUR OWN SIM

Messages go out on your own number and your own mobile plan, at whatever your operator charges. We add nothing, and nothing is routed through our servers. Farmers see a message from you, not from an unknown code.

YOUR MESSAGES STAY ON YOUR PHONE

Message content is never uploaded, never stored on our servers, and never used for advertising. It is read on your phone and stays there. Full policy: https://dairywala.in/privacy

WHAT YOU GET

• Inbox with all your conversations
• Send and receive text messages
• Notifications with quick reply
• Works with two SIM cards
• Hindi throughout
• Automatic milk receipts, if you use the Dairywala app
• Delivery confirmation on every receipt
• Small and light — built for the phones dairy owners actually carry

Dairywala SMS needs to be set as your default messaging app to send and receive messages. You can change that back at any time in your phone's settings.

DairyWalla – Digital Catalog & Order Management for Dairy Distributors

DairyWalla is a simple digital catalog and order management platform built for dairy and ice-cream distributors, shopkeepers, kirana stores, dairy booths, and local retail businesses.

Many dairy distributors still manage daily orders through phone calls, WhatsApp messages, and manual notebooks. This often creates confusion, missed orders, wrong quantities, late-order issues, and scattered order history.

DairyWalla helps make this process more organized by allowing distributors and their linked shopkeepers to manage dairy orders digitally in one place.

For Distributors

With DairyWalla, distributors can manage:

• Product catalog
• Product pricing
• Product units such as crate, box, packet, litre, kg, etc.
• Stock availability
• Order window timing
• Delivery areas
• Linked shopkeepers
• Daily order requests
• Order status
• Order history

Distributors can create and update their own product catalog, manage availability, view shopkeeper orders, and keep their daily order workflow more structured.

For Shopkeepers

Shopkeepers can use DairyWalla to view the catalog shared by their linked distributor and place order requests digitally.

Shopkeepers can:

• View distributor-specific product catalog
• Select dairy and ice-cream products
• Add quantity
• Place order requests
• Track order status
• View previous orders

This helps reduce confusion caused by calls, messages, and manual order notes.

Why DairyWalla?

DairyWalla is designed to help local dairy businesses save time, reduce manual order confusion, and maintain better order records.

Key benefits:

• Reduces call and message-based order chaos
• Helps avoid missed orders
• Makes order requests more structured
• Keeps product and pricing details organized
• Helps distributors manage shopkeeper orders digitally
• Maintains order history for better tracking
• Simple and easy-to-use interface for local businesses

Built for Indian Dairy Businesses

DairyWalla is built with the needs of Indian dairy distributors and shopkeepers in mind. Whether you deal in milk, curd, paneer, ice cream, or other dairy products, DairyWalla helps you manage your catalog and daily orders in a more organized way.

Important Note

DairyWalla does not manufacture, store, sell, deliver, or supply dairy products directly. Product catalog, pricing, stock availability, billing, delivery, quality, and fulfillment are managed by the respective distributor.

DairyWalla only provides digital catalog and order management software for distributors and shopkeepers.

Who Can Use DairyWalla?

DairyWalla is useful for:

• Dairy distributors
• Ice-cream distributors
• Milk distributors
• Dairy product suppliers
• Kirana stores
• Dairy booths
• Local shopkeepers
• Retail outlets

DairyWalla helps simplify daily dairy order management and brings local dairy distribution one step closer to digital operations.

DairyWalla – Simplifying dairy distribution, one order at a time.
